descriptionChirho: The Babylonian official Nebuzaradan, captain of the guard under Nebuchadnezzar, who oversaw the destruction of Jerusalem and the deportation of Judah. S115504 appears to capture a partial rendering or title fragment ('chief', spa 'Adan', arb 'أَدَانُ'), but still refers to the same individual. Multilingual evidence: eng 'Nevuzaradan/chief', spa 'Nebuzaradán', hin 'नबूजरदान', arb 'نَبُوزَرْأَدَانُ', kor '느부사라단', swa 'Nebuzaradani/mkuu-wa'.
